title: APIs That Make Apps Feel Premium
summary: Lists 5 APIs to add premium polish to apps: Mapbox for custom maps, Resend for transactional email, Clerk for auth with polished UI, Stream for chat/feeds/video, and Cloudinary for image/video optimization and delivery.
concepts: Mapbox custom maps and location features
Stream real-time chat and activity feeds
Cloudinary image and video optimization via CDN
